name: features-section-demo-2
title: Icon Feature Grid
description: Arranges eight icon-led features in a responsive four-column grid with thin dividers. Each cell shows a line icon, a bold title with a short accent bar and a short description; hovering lights the bar blue.
use: A product page needs a compact icon-led feature grid with a subtle hover cue.
avoid: The eight features and icons are hardcoded, and the thin dividers nearly vanish on light themes.
a11y: Icons are decorative SVGs with no label, titles are plain divs not headings, and the hover glow has no keyboard equivalent. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A four-by-two grid of feature cells separated by thin dark borders on a near-black page. Each cell carries a small line icon, a bold white title with a short vertical bar to its left, and a few lines of grey copy.
behaves: Hovering a cell fades in a soft gradient from below, turns its left bar blue and slides the title slightly right. The rest of the grid stays still.
customise: Nothing is exposed; the titles, descriptions and icon choices sit in a local array inside the file.
weight: light: Eight static cells with a CSS hover gradient and one small icon each.
